messages:
Rina (PM): Quick thread to align scope for the observability console kickoff. Goal: ship a minimal set that surfaces cost drivers, traces for hot paths, and fast error triage. My proposed cut: 1) two dashboard templates (cost by model, latency by route), 2) a trace hook toggle per-route, 3) an errors summary card with top 5 messages. Thoughts?
Carlos (Backend): Looks good. One thing: cost by model requires token attribution at model-invoke time. We currently emit model_id but not token counts per request in the prod stream. Need a tiny telemetry change. Estimate: 2 dev-days to add and backfill for 7d retention.
Priya (SRE): If we add token-level telemetry, watch cardinality. For dashboards, default aggregation should be by model and by route only. No free-text tags. Also recommend an opt-in high-cardinality view for debug.
Hannah (Design): UX constraints: the error summary card should show top-5 (count, rate-change %) and a one-click drilldown to traces. Compact card must fit in a 3-column layout. I'll mock variants with and without sparklines.
Ibrahim (Data): For cost schema, propose fields: [route, model, customer_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, cached_tokens, timestamp, request_id]. If request_id is present we can join traces later. If we avoid request_id for privacy we can still do aggregated rolls.
Rina (PM): Good point on privacy. For Private deployments we can include request_id as opt-in for enterprise. Public hosted default: no request_id. Note this affects trace linking. Mark trace linking as non-MVP for hosted.
Carlos (Backend): Implementation plan: emit tokens_out for each response in event stream. Add a small sampling flag for request_id to avoid PII in hosted by default: request_id sampled at 0.1%.
Priya (SRE): Sampling default should be conservative. Also add a quota check: if a customer enables higher sampling, surface potential delta in backend cost estimate. We can surface a monthly estimated token delta in the UI.
Hannah (Design): UX acceptance criteria: enabling sampling shows an inline estimate, confirmation modal with warning, and an option "persist for N days". Also the trace hook UI must let you set per-route sampling buckets and show current effective sampling rate.
Ibrahim (Data): For dashboard performance gate: queries that render templates must return within 1.5s p95 on staging with 7d of rollups. If not, we fallback to precomputed rollups for last-7d.
Rina (PM): Launch criteria draft: - Dashboard templates available in console, with cost/latency charts; - Trace toggle per-route that writes config and honors sampling server-side; - Error card with top-5 and trace link (trace link may only work for Private/opt-in initially). Non-MVP: full trace linking for hosted. Agree?
Carlos (Backend): Agree. Add a runtime safety: server rejects sampling >0.5 by default for hosted, require enterprise flag to relax.
Priya (SRE): Also add an observability reliability gate: if trace ingestion falls behind >30s for 5m window, UI should mark traces as delayed and dashboards keep serving cached rollups. Ops-bot: create incident alert when ingestion lag >30s.
ops-bot: alert created: observability_trace_lag > 30s for 5m -> incident ticket #OBS-742.
Hannah (Design): I'll deliver high-fi mocks for the dashboard and error card by Monday COB and a compact flow for enabling sampling.
Ibrahim (Data): I'll prepare the rollup job template and an example schema. Engineers: expect a small migration on the metrics topic.
Rina (PM): Prioritization: sprint A: dashboards + token telemetry schema (HIGH); sprint B: trace toggle API + UI (MED); sprint C: error card + trace linking for Private (LOW). Canary: 3% of orgs on staging->prod canary for 48h, monitor query latency and token delta.
Carlos (Backend): I'll open the runtime PR for telemetry changes today. ETA: 4 business days for full end-to-end.
Priya (SRE): +1. I'll add rollout alarms: dashboard p95 > baseline*1.25 or token spike > 15% -> auto-block rollout.
Rina (PM): Thanks all. I'll update the roadmap doc and post a follow-up with acceptance text. If someone wants to nudge reprioritization, reply here. :thumbsup:
